jobs.title: Senior Risk Management Consultant - Professions
jobs.description:
Who Are We?
Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Risk Control
Target Openings

1
What Is the Opportunity?

We're looking for an enthusiastic and commercially minded Senior Risk Management Consultant to join our Professions team in London, working across a portfolio that spans solicitors, accountants, surveyors and engineers. In this interesting and varied role, you'll analyse claims data to identify trends and recurring errors, advise clients on how to manage and mitigate their exposures, and work closely with underwriters to provide insight on risk and regulatory issues.

You'll be a confident communicator who thrives in front of an audience — whether that's presenting to insured firms on how to reduce their risk, organising and hosting client risk seminars, or engaging with professional bodies and third-party organisations. If you're passionate about helping professional services firms understand and manage their risks more effectively, and come from a legal, underwriting, claims or risk management background we’d love to hear from you.

Travelers Europe currently offers flexibility to employees who wish to work on a hybrid basis in accordance with our Hybrid Work Arrangements Policy. This entails full time employees working three days a week in the office and two days at home (or pro rata for part-time employees). This policy may be changed at the Company’s discretion. What Will You Do?
- Supports and develops the Travelers value added risk management proposition across the Professions portfolio.
- Advises customers on risk management issues, by responding to requests for information and advice.
- Coordinates visit requests from underwriters and proactively contacts in conjunction with fellow risk managers direct insureds (and non-direct cases via their broker) paying more than £10,000 premium to ensure they have been made aware of our risk management offering.
- Visits customers- firms, either at their request or at the request of the underwriters, and prepares a report dealing with current risk exposure, claims history (if appropriate) and ways in which they could reduce risk. This includes advising the underwriters as to the perception of future risk that the firm may present.
- Researches and prepares written materials, including Gazette columns, items for the solicitor's bulletin, and any other articles that may be requested, either in house or for external publications.
- Researches, prepares and presents seminars, in-house to customers at their request, or for external bodies such as local Law Societies, or other organisations (e.g. CLT) as requested.
- Researches, develops and prepares relevant materials (such as the Risk Management factsheets, best practice guides).
- Assists the underwriters as requested with advice on legal or professional practice issues.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?
- University degree and/or Chartered Insurance Institute (CII) Certification.

- Working knowledge of insurance/underwriting.

- Working knowledge of organizational and regulatory rules, policies and procedures and effectively employs that knowledge in day to day work activities.

- Intermediate Relationship Management: Seeks out, builds, fosters and maintains productive relationships or alliances to meet goals and achieve objectives.

- Basic Business Perspective: Uses knowledge of internal and external factors that impact the Lloyd's Market to make decisions.

- Intermediate Analytical Thinking/Financial Acumen: Identifies current or future problems or opportunities, analyzes, synthesizes and compares information to understand issues, identifies cause/effect relationships, and explores alternatives to support sound decision making.

- Intermediate Product/Technical: Demonstrates technical proficiency and application of knowledge commensurate to his/her experience.

- Makes sound risk recommendations that are in the Company's best interests.

- Intermediate Regulatory and Compliance: Understands, adheres to, applies and enforces Corporate policies, procedures and standards, and complies with Travelers' regulatory obligations.

What is a Must Have?
- General knowledge of risk management process.

What Is in It for You?
- Private Medical Insuran ce:  On commencement of employment, you are eligible for single cover provided by Travelers, with the option to add cover for your dependents, at your expense through payroll deduction.
- Retirement: Travelers will make a core contribution of a percentage of salary to your Pension Plan. Additionally, if you decide to contribute to the plan, you will receive an increased company contribution.
- Holiday Entitlement:  Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 25 days holiday entitlement annually, plus the opportunity to purchase additional days to allow for up to a total of 35 holidays per year.
- Wellness Programme: The Travelers wellness programme is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health programme provides access to free professional counseling services and other resources that support your daily life needs.
- Volunteer Encouragement:  We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards programme that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices
Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/ .

jobs.title: Director, Business Strategy, EUR
jobs.description:
Who Are We?
Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Project Management
Target Openings

1
What Is the Opportunity?

The role requires a working command of the insurance value chain - how risk originates and flows from insured through retail broker, wholesale broker and MGA to carrier, where underwriting authority is held or delegated at each step. It requires an understanding of insurance financials: rate adequacy and loss ratio development, the acquisition cost stack, expense ratio drivers, and differing level of the capital intensity and volatility of a class. And it requires a commercial read on two markets that behave very differently - a subscription London Market shaped by Lloyd's oversight, lead and follow economics, facilities and delegated authority, and a retail market shaped by broker consolidation, carrier panel rationalisation, schemes and e-trade. We are looking for someone who brings that understanding on day one. This is a strategy advisory role, not programme, portfolio or transformation management.
• Strategy Formulation: Provide leadership and hands-on support to deliver key strategic initiatives, including strategic reviews, market horizon scanning, competitor benchmarking, and market insight development.

• Investment Framework: Shape the translation of strategy into a set of investment priorities that advance Travelers Europe’s market offering, capabilities, and operating model. Provide strategic insight to inform investment prioritisation and ensure alignment with business strategy objectives.

• Strategy Communications: Provide leadership on clear and effective communication of Travelers Europe’s business strategy, working with Corporate Communications and business stakeholders to ensure visibility of strategic priorities, progress, and outcomes.

• Performance Framework: Establish and mature performance frameworks including OKRs and KPIs, to monitor strategic progress, drive accountability, and support disciplined execution across priority initiatives.

• Strategic leader and critical thinker with a pragmatic, commercially minded leadership approach.

• Trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, skilled at navigating ambiguity, shaping strategic priorities, and building consensus with senior stakeholders.

• Highly proactive, resilient, and tenacious in driving progress across complex initiatives and maintaining momentum through challenge or uncertainty.

• Operates with significant autonomy and sound judgement, while knowing when to engage, influence, or escalate appropriately.

• Embodies Travelers’ values through integrity, innovation, customer focus, and a clear commitment to commercial outcomes.

Preferred Qualification s
• Degree in Business, Economics, Strategy, Finance, or a related discipline.
• Understanding of the London and European insurance markets, including regulatory frameworks, customer and distribution trends, and competitive dynamics.
• Experience in corporate strategy, business transformation, strategic planning, or a related discipline within a complex, multi-line organisation.
• Experience working with executive stakeholders and cross-functional teams to align activity around shared strategic objectives.
• Strong financial and analytical acumen, with the ability to assess portfolio performance, growth opportunities, investment priorities, and key performance metrics.
• Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and translate analysis into clear, compelling insight for diverse audiences.
• Experience working across geographies and cultures, ideally within a global financial services or insurance organisation.

Minimum Qualifications
• Relevant strategy leadership experience, including proven success in corporate strategy, management consulting, or senior strategic roles within insurance or financial services.

What Is in It for You?
- Private Medical Insuran ce:  On commencement of employment, you are eligible for single cover provided by Travelers, with the option to add cover for your dependents, at your expense through payroll deduction.
- Retirement: Travelers will make a core contribution of a percentage of salary to your Pension Plan. Additionally, if you decide to contribute to the plan, you will receive an increased company contribution.
- Holiday Entitlement:  Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 25 days holiday entitlement annually, plus the opportunity to purchase additional days to allow for up to a total of 35 holidays per year.
- Wellness Programme: The Travelers wellness programme is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health programme provides access to free professional counseling services and other resources that support your daily life needs.
- Volunteer Encouragement:  We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards programme that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices
Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

jobs.title: Investment Analyst Development Program
jobs.description:
Who Are We?
Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Investments
Compensation Overview
The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range
$81,500.00 - $134,500.00
Target Openings

4
What Is the Opportunity?

Develops the skills, through independent and on-the-job training, to become an investment analyst.

This two-year program introduces people who have an interest and aptitude for the investment management industry to all aspects of fixed-income capital markets. The position will provide meaningful, challenging work opportunities in various areas of the fixed income department. The program is designed to emphasize one of two tracks - Credit or Quantitative - and involves both project-oriented and recurring assignments in support of fixed income analysts and portfolio managers.

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role. What Will You Do?
- Job duties will vary based on market conditions and department needs, with responsibilities expanding progressively as appropriate.

CREDIT TRACK:
Credit Research Associate Analysts play an active role in evaluating new and existing securities, sectors and asset classes. Core responsibilities include:
- Monitoring news and externally generated research pertinent to existing and potential securities holdings and communicating this information in a timely and effective manner.
- Presentation of historical and pro forma financial statement results and associated credit analysis ratios.
- Utilizing analytics software and databases to develop or refine tools and models used in credit, securities and portfolio analysis process.
- Preparation of reports designed to track deal flow or identify credit or portfolio performance trends.
- Fundamental credit, sector and asset class research.
- Engaging with issuer representatives, sell-side analysts and rating agency professionals through in-person meetings, telephonic discussions, and webcasts.
- Presenting investment, portfolio and/or sector analysis in formal and ad-hoc meeting formats.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

QUANTITATIVE TRACK:
Quantitative Research Associate Analysts play an active role in the use and development of models and processes for analyzing portfolio performance and risk. Core responsibilities include:
- Utilizing modeling software, analytical tools, databases and other decision aids in support of recurring and ad-hoc portfolio, transaction, and credit analysis needs.
- Performing return attribution analysis and evaluating the results.
- Designing and building enhanced analytics for modeling fixed income securities.
- Participating in the development and implementation of new tools, models and reports to support the portfolio management process.
- Preparing reports designed to identify and monitor risk or aid in the analysis of portfolios, transactions, sectors or credits.
- Assisting in the maintenance of the treasury futures portfolio.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?
- Team experience and internship or other practical work experience are required.
- Candidates should demonstrate initiative, leadership potential, versatility, follow-through, sound analytical thinking, strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to deliver high-quality work.

SUGGESTED MAJORS:
- Credit Track: Finance/Accounting, Economics, Political Science, Liberal Arts
- Quantitative Track: Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science

What is a Must Have?
- Bachelor's Degree with minimum GPA of 3.5.

What Is in It for You?
- Health Insurance : Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
- Retirement:  Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
- Paid Time Off:  Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
- Wellness Program:  The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
- Volunteer Encouragement:  We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices
Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.
